mechanism: Pyrazinamide may increase uric acid levels and interfere with folate metabolism, while folic acid supplementation can help mitigate pyrazinamide-induced hyperuricemia and potential hematologic effects.
action: Monitor serum uric acid levels and consider folic acid supplementation (1-5 mg daily) during pyrazinamide therapy, particularly in patients with gout history or renal impairment.
